technical_and_design_decisions: Use Spring Shell to implement the shell interface for the Spring Cloud Data Flow REST API.
Leverage Spring Boot @ConfigurationProperties to derive module metadata for the 'module info' command.
Port existing Spring XD modules (http, tcp, twitterstream, twittersearch, filter, transform) to Spring Cloud Stream compatible modules.
Implement modules as Spring Cloud Stream applications using functional programming model.
Use Maven for building and managing module dependencies.
Follow Spring Cloud Stream binders pattern for integration with messaging middleware.
assumptions: The developer has prior experience with Spring Framework, Spring Boot, and Spring Cloud Stream.
Existing Spring XD module code can be adapted with minimal refactoring for Spring Cloud Stream compatibility.
The shell interface will support basic CRUD operations for stream commands.
Module metadata will be exposed via standard Spring Boot configuration properties.
All modules will be implemented as standalone Spring Boot applications.
Testing will be performed using Spring Boot test utilities and JUnit 5.

activities.activity_description: Implement shell interface for Spring Cloud Data Flow REST API with stream commands support using Spring Shell.
Design and implement strategy for deriving module metadata via @ConfigurationProperties for the 'module info' command.
Port http module from Spring XD to Spring Cloud Stream as a source module.
Port tcp module from Spring XD to Spring Cloud Stream as a source module.
Port twitterstream module from Spring XD to Spring Cloud Stream as a source module.
Port twittersearch module from Spring XD to Spring Cloud Stream as a source module.
Port filter module from Spring XD to Spring Cloud Stream as a processor module.
Port transform module from Spring XD to Spring Cloud Stream as a processor module.
Integrate all modules and shell interface, perform end-to-end testing and bug fixing.
